facts.fact: Radio Tamazuj reports the Transitional National Legislative Assembly unanimously passed the Cybercrime and Computer Misuse Bill 2025 on 25 November 2025, a bill first issued as a provisional order in May 2021 and tabled in September 2024; it had not yet been signed.
